question: Should workflow completion be supported through the existing typed plugin lifecycle hooks and an external plugin, or should OpenClaw add a distinct internal `session:end` event with defined terminal semantics?
rationale: The current plugin API offers adjacent events, but persistent-session rollover, agent-run completion, and subagent completion are observably different moments; selecting one as the public orchestration contract requires maintainer product and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Standardize on the plugin contract
options.body: Document the suitable `agent_end`, `session_end`, and `subagent_ended` semantics and direct a Temporal-style integration to a ClawHub code plugin.

options.title: Add a narrow internal event
options.body: Define an additive internal `session:end` event with an explicit lifecycle matrix, payload, ordering, failure behavior, and focused coverage for every supported terminal path.

recommendation.title: Standardize on the plugin contract
recommendation.body: Document the suitable `agent_end`, `session_end`, and `subagent_ended` semantics and direct a Temporal-style integration to a ClawHub code plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects Vincent directly to the split between session hook event types and the current session lifecycle implementation.
